prompts.label: banner
prompts.text: Wide horizontal composition (16:9, 1200px wide) featuring a warm, inviting scene where gentle hands are holding a personalized birthstone necklace, with a cozy armchair draped in a soft weighted blanket visible in the background, a digital photo frame glowing softly with family memories, and an engraved watch resting nearby, all arranged in an organic flow with floating elements suggesting thoughtfulness and care. The scene is set against a soft gradient background transitioning smoothly from teal to coral-orange, with subtle abstract shapes (small circles, stars, and dots) scattered throughout in complementary tones. Soft, diffused lighting creates a warm, inviting atmosphere with gentle shadows grounding each element. Modern flat illustration with soft 3D-style characters and objects, combined with subtle 2D decorative elements. Use warm, vibrant pastels (teal #00A99D, coral-orange #FF6B35, sunshine yellow #FFD700). All objects feature rounded edges, smooth matte surfaces, and clean lines. Layout must be clean and giftable, using rounded forms, balanced negative space, and minimal visual clutter. The tone should feel cheerful, light, editorial, and creative — never realistic or photorealistic. No text, logos, or watermarks.
